lightning_text.configuration.title: Lightning Text
lightning_text.configuration.enableTitle: Whether to display the text shadow.
lightning_text.configuration.enableDayTi: Show a big banner whenever a new in-game day begins (also when sleeping).
lightning_text.configuration.enableBiome: Show a big banner the first time you enter a biome.
lightning_text.configuration.enableBossT: Show a big banner the first time you see a boss (For example: ender dragon, wither, c:bosses tag, warden, elder guardian, chicken jockey).
lightning_text.configuration.enableTitle: Play thunder sound together with day, biome and boss banners.
lightning_text.configuration.fontPath.to: TrueType font used for the banners. Empty = auto-detect SimHei / a system CJK font.
Multiplier for the maximum banner size.
lightning_text.configuration.biomeDetect: Ticks to stay in a biome before its banner is shown.
